Package org.codehaus.mojo.versions.utils

Class TextAssertions

java.lang.Object
org.codehaus.mojo.versions.utils.TextAssertions
public final class TextAssertions extends Object
Assertions on text and collections that JUnit does not have, each reporting what it checked when it fails.
